snippet.title: Big Bad Pharma Trailer #1
snippet.description:
So for the last few months, my nights and weekends have been spent building Big Bad Pharma in Unreal Engine 5. It’s a cozy shelf-stocking pharmacy tidy up game on the surface, restock shelves, build up your store. But underneath the cute wolf-pharmacist mascot and the mint and sage colour palette, it’s got a satirical edge about the industry itself.

This is my first ever Steam release, built entirely by me under my own studio, Middlewood Studio. No team, no funding, just something I needed to make.

If cozy sims with a bit of bite sound like your thing, I’d love for you to check it out and wishlist it. It genuinely helps more than people realise for a first-time solo dev.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4953610/Big_Bad_Pharma/

#gaming #indiegame
